cobblemon:
Cobblemon is an open-source Pokémon mod for Fabric and NeoForge. 
 The goal of Cobblemon is to be the Pokémon mod for everyone, and to integrate much better into modpacks and Minecraft itself than other Pokémon mods. Our source code is open to encourage not only community contributions, but also forking. 
 
 
 
 Features (so far!): 
 
 Capture Pokémon to expand your team, battle wild Pokémon to gain experience, level up to unlock new moves, and evolve your Pokémon. There are over 800 Pokémon to catch! 
 Battles using the Pokémon Showdown! engine for accurate competitive battle mechanics. 
 Some Legends Arceus -style mechanics, such as move relearning, physically running from battle, and evolving your Pokémon when you decide. 
 Toggle free-movement during battles. You can build, mine, or fight mobs while in Poké

There will be no more updates for LMR. This mod is not maintained anymore. Please use other resource loader mods instead.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 Dependencies

 Fabric
- Fabric API (Only for Fabric)

 About 

"Load My Resources" is a client-side mod to automatically load resources like images and sounds on game start. 
It's like using a resource pack, but it is enabled by default and can't be disabled by the user. 
On top of that, it's hidden from the resource pack menu, so you don't need to worry about a useless pack entry!

 How to Load Resources

Loading resources is not very difficult, but if you absolutely don't know how resource packs work, please watch a YouTube tutorial first or this will be a bit hard for you.

1. To generate all important directories and files, start the game one time with the mod installed and close it again.
2. Open the newly generated folder named 'resources'

Quicksand generates in Deserts and acts similarly to Powder Snow. You will sink into Quicksand unless wearing Leather Boots. Once you're submerged you'll start drowning in it! You'll want to escape quickly.

You can pick up Quicksand in Buckets and put it in Cauldrons if you want. Dunno why you'd want to, but you can.

If a Zombie ends up submerged in Quicksand for too long, it becomes a Husk. That's kinda neat, isn't it?

This mod is for Fabric.

packagedexcrafting:
PackagedExCrafting is an addon to PackagedAuto and Extended Crafting , and it adds the ability to automatically craft items made using Extended Crafting's crafting tables more easily. This mod is designed to be able to run without Applied Energistics 2, but installation with it is recommended. 
 This mod adds many crafters. To use them, put one next to an Unpackager, and have the Unpackager handle respective crafting recipes, which can be encoded into recipe holders with the Encoder. The Ender and Flux crafters requires their respective Alternators, and the Combination crafter requires a sufficient amount of Marked Pedestals. The crafters, when connected to a ME Network, will automatically eject outputs into the network.
wandering-collector:
This Minecraft mod that takes the Wandering Trader concept from one of SimplySarc's suggestion videos and implements it.

Whenever a player dropped item despawns/gets destroyed, the stacks get internally added to a list and have a chance to show up next time when trading with a Wandering Trader.

Of course, you can legitimately trade your items back only once ;)

solid_mobs:
Solid Mobs

---

 

---

 About

A Minecraft Fabric mod that gives entities collisions and interactions like blocks or boats already do.

Standing on a mob has you move with them, and you can hold crouch to stick to the mob and not fall off (as can happen with high lag).

Slimes can be set to be bouncy like slime blocks.

Mobs can be set to take a percentage of fall damage when fallen on.

The config( "minecraft/config/solid mobs.json" ) and command ( /solid mobs ) allows tweaking of certain collisions, for example you can disable player collisions, pet collisions, & even tweak the amount of fall damage transferred to mobs being fallen onto.

For multiplayer this mod MUST be on both the server and client , (single player is fine) otherwise you will have stuttering and de-sync while colliding with mobs (you won't crash or any issue like that, but it is annoying) .

Fabric Language Kotlin

mealapi:
Meal API
 A Fabric Modding API for more filling foods.
Requires Fabric API 

 
 Features
 A new food bar! 
- Not used by vanilla food, meaning this mod has no effect without other mods that make use of it. 
- Usable by modded food items, which can add a "fullness" restoration amount to their food items. 
- The fullness bar stores up to the equivalent of 180 extra food points, in a sort of "overflow" way. 
- Saturation and hunger will always be completely full when the fullness bar is filled more than 0. 
- The fullness bar gets depleted instead of hunger or saturation, unless at 0. 
- If a "meal" food doesn't completely fill the normal hunger/saturation bar when eaten, some of its fullness value will go to making up for that. 
- Since saturation is always full when your fullness bar is filled, you can heal very fast while full, but at the cost of the fullness bar being depleted very quic

This mod adds "desire paths" to your world -- as you trace the same paths over and over, the blocks will slowly change beneath your feet.

Raised Clouds

 
 
 

Allows changing the height at which clouds appear.

Raised Clouds requires the Fabric modloader.

 Installation

1. Download Raised Clouds from CurseForge or GitHub.
2. Place the downloaded file in your mods folder.

 Configuration

The configuration can be edited in the config/raisedclouds.json file or using the Mod Menu mod. Descriptions and values for each configuration option are available in-game when using Mod Menu.

 Usage

By default, Raised Clouds does not make any changes to the Y position of clouds. However, it can be configured to override or scale the base Y and anchor the position to the camera.

All Roads
Generate roads between structures.

 What?
by default, AllRoads will find 10 villages and generate 4 roads.
The roads are obvious over land, but still have waypoints over water

 Other Structures?
In general, any structure that is in a structure tag can have a
road generated between it

To invoke a road generation, you must first add a "road plan" using AllRoads.ROAD GENERATOR.addRoadPlan(BlockPos[] plan) 

a road plan is simply a 2-length array of BlockPos, being the start and end positions (of structures)

after adding all your road plans, you can use the method AllRoads.ROAD GENERATOR.planNextRoad(MinecraftServer server) 

This will then continue to generate roads until there are none left.

This mod requires Async Locator. if your going to use your own structures,
I'd recommend using it as well

MEG Client Mod

A client-side Minecraft mod that optimizes Model Engine animation packets by replacing per-entity metadata updates with a single bulk payload using half-precision encoding, significantly reducing bandwidth usage for complex models.

 Supported Platforms

- Fabric
- Forge
- NeoForge

 Minecraft: 1.19.4 - 1.21.x

 How It Works

When installed, the mod registers the modelengine:bulk data plugin channel. The Model Engine server plugin detects this and sends optimized bulk animation packets instead of individual entity data updates. Transformation data (position, rotation, scale) is encoded as half-precision floats, cutting payload size roughly in half compared to vanilla packets.

Players without the mod receive standard packets as usual, no compatibility issues.

 Installation

Auto Log Remover

A simple mod that automatically deletes old log files to reduce clutter and freeing up disk space. No more manually cleaning your logs! Works both for client logs and server logs.

The mod is set to delete any logs 14 days by default, which can be changed. Alternately, a limit on logs can also be set, which will delete older logs after reaching a set amount.

This mod should support most minecraft versions, although versions below 1.20 are untested.

 Config

Configuration is done through autologremover.properties file, located in /config .

- deletion-mode : Either days or limit [Default: days] 
 - days (Delete logs after X amount of days)
 - limit (Delete old logs after reaching X number of logs.)

- max-log-days : How long to keep logs until they are deleted. [Default: 14] 
- max-log-limit : How many log file can exist at once before getting deleted. [Default: 10]

dynres:
DynRes uses an integrated web server to serve a resource pack directly from the server directory.
It also modifies the server to specify that pack as the default (overwrites resource-pack and resource-pack-sha1 in server.properties).
You can configure the port for the web server, the file to host and whether to provide a hash in the config.

To use this mod on your server you need to place your resource pack in the configured place (default: server/resources.zip)
and change baseLink in the config to your public address (what players will enter)

This mod is only required on your server. If added to a client the only thing it will do is log some information about server connections

Vibes

Vibes adds a new item, the Vibe, that lets you play music discs on the go without needing a jukebox.

Vibes try to position their music logically, which means that putting a Vibe inside a chest while it's still playing will move the sound source to the chest's position. This not only works with chests, but with all vanilla storage blocks, storage minecarts, shulker boxes, and item frames.

Dropping a Vibe on the ground will move the sound source to the item entity, and picking it up will move the sound source back to you, the player.

A Vibe can also be docked into a jukebox (by right clicking like a regular disc) to amplify its range!

 Crafting

A Vibe can be crafted with 1 Jukebox and 4 Iron Ingots .

 

 Usage

The mechanics for Vibe are very similar to how the bundle is used.

 Playing Discs

1. Pick up the Vibe
1. Hover over the disc
1. Right click the disc with the Vibe

donut-order:
Notes

Lightweight singleplayer mod that recreates a DonutSMP-inspired orders menu for testing order flows, pricing, item amounts, and collection behavior locally.

This mod is intentionally for singleplayer only. It is not a DonutSMP cheat, macro, script, bypass, marketplace bot, or public-server automation tool.

 

 Features

- Opens with /order or /orders 
- Includes refresh, sort, filter, search, and your-orders controls
- Create new orders through a DonutSMP-style item selection flow
- Edit item, amount, and price before confirming
- Price 0 is allowed
- Amount 0 creates an infinite order
- Confirmed orders are instantly delivered locally
- Finite orders can be collected or dropped
- Infinite orders can be collected repeatedly
- Includes cancel confirmation before deleting an order

 

 Commands

 text
/order
/orders

zstd-compresser:
English

Provides a high-compression Zstd data stream for Minecraft multiplayer, replacing the vanilla Zlib compression pipeline to significantly reduce bandwidth usage. Supports cooperative operation between a client-side Mod and a Velocity server plugin.

 How It Works

All game packets exchanged between the client and server are batched together before encryption and compressed using the Zstd algorithm. Compared to vanilla Zlib, Zstd can reduce data size by 50%–80% at the same compression speed. Automatic dictionary training is also supported to further improve compression ratios.

 Supported Versions

 Fabric: 1.21.1, 1.20.1
 Forge: 1.20.1
 Neoforge: 1.21.1
 Velocity: 3.4.0+

 Compatibility

Known compatible with:

 ViaVersion
 limboauth

 Features

 Transparent Replacement : Seamlessly takes over the vanilla compression pipeline without requiring server configuration changes
 Batch

This mod adds a command /letmecc and an item tool ( letmecc:let me cc ) for viewing and editing the inventory of any living entity. You can install this library using Jitpack

 groovy
include modImplementation("com.github.0x3C50:Renderer:master-SNAPSHOT")

deathchest:
Death Chest Datapack

When a player dies, items in their inventory are stored in a chest minecart.

 Tested Version

- 1.21.11

 Specifications

- Upon death, a chest minecart is summoned at the death location.
- Items held at the time of death are stored in the chest minecart.
- If a player dies by falling into the End void, a chest will float on the ground at y=0 or their current coordinates.
- The summoned chest minecart will emit a beacon to indicate its location.
- If the chest minecart is loaded, the direction of the chest minecart will be displayed to the owner (the deceased player).
- The name of the player who died in the chest minecart is displayed to identify the player.
- The chest will automatically disappear 30 minutes after death (items will be dropped).
- Time will not be counted if the chest is not loaded.
- This will not work properly unless keepInventory is set to true

Simple Config Lib

 Simple Config Lib is a library for Minecraft mods designed to handle settings. It lets a developer describe a configuration with an ordinary Java class, after which the library automatically builds an in-game settings screen and takes care of saving and loading the data.

The main goal of the project is to free developers from routinely implementing a settings system and to provide a single, predictable result across all supported platforms.

 The library supports the Fabric , Forge , and NeoForge loaders.

 Detailed documentation is available in the wiki: Simple Config Lib Wiki

 

---

 Purpose

The library provides a unified way to work with mod settings, covering configuration description, storage, and display.

Simple Config Lib offers a single approach to solving this task:

- the configuration is described once as a class;
- the settings screen is generated aut

---

 Slice Replenishment: When mods that support cake/pie slices, such as Farmer's Delight, are installed, you can use slices to replenish the corresponding cake/pie blocks.

 
 
 Fall Damage Reduction: Landing on a cake can reduce fall damage. However, be aware that falling from a significant height might not only reduce damage but could also destroy the cake.

 

 Silk Touch Harvesting: Tools with the "Silk Touch" enchantment can be used to harvest complete cake blocks.

All of these features are configurable.

nosession:
NoSession
NoSession is a mod that protects your session ID. 
 Does this make me perfectly safe?
This mod doesn't make you 100% safe, but it makes it much harder to steal your session token. If you want to stay perfectly safe, look at the
staying safe section

 Staying Safe
In order to work around an unpatchable security vulnerability, rename the NoSession jar to !.jar so it can load its protection before any other mods. 
This only protects you from other mods. There are fake verification sites that can steal your session ID through that method. 
Don't login with Microsoft OAuth to anything except maybe your Minecraft launcher. You may also want to verify the signature on any NoSession binary. It's signed with pandaninjas' GPG key.

See ILikePlayingGames' SkyblockModSafety guide for other information

 Support
Support is provided in The Fight Against Malware's discord server

Player Teleport:

Return to Previous:

phantom-lucidity:
Phantom Lucidity

 
 
 

Allows players to opt into fighting phantoms.

Phantom Lucidity requires the Fabric modloader and Fabric API.

 Installation

1. Install Fabric API if it is not installed.
2. Download Phantom Lucidity from CurseForge or GitHub.
3. Place the downloaded file in your mods folder.

 Usage

When this mod is installed, phantoms will spawn with a translucent appearance. In this state, phantoms will not make noise and will not attempt to attack players. In addition, if killed in this state, phantoms will not drop loot or experience.

Players can look at a phantom through a spyglass to reveal it. After a phantom has been revealed, it will resume its normal attack behavior and drop loot if killed.

 Tags

Items added to the phantomlucidity:phantoms revealed while using tag will reveal phantoms while they are actively being used. Spyglasses are in this tag by default.

zots-only-silver:
Back in the day, the original Simple Ores from Minecraft 1.5.2 or earlier had silver ore instead of tin ore. The original author, AleXndrtheGr8st/Skrallexy, removed silver ore and replaced it with tin ore in Minecraft 1.6.4. It turns out that there was still some demand for a silver ore, so Zot201 created Only Silver as an add-on for SimpleOres that put back silver ore and silver tools, and added some enchantments for silver items and, eventually, a silver golem. Zot201 maintained the original OnlySilver through Minecraft 1.7.10, 1.8, 1.9.4, and 1.10.2. Alas, Zot201 is no longer maintaining their old mods. Fortunately, they licensed it with a FOSS (free and open source) license, that allows others to port and modify the original mod. 

Not only is silver a metal in demand for many tech mods, OnlySilver (or other source of silver) is also a required dependency for one of akkamaddi's mods

 Minecraft 26.3 support is now available: download 1.1.1+26.3 for Fabric. Use the JAR and Fabric API that match your Minecraft version.

 Hurt one member of the herd and watch the whole flock lose it, now with Farm Fear™ intensity settings. 

In vanilla Minecraft, livestock couldn't care less when their neighbor gets bonked. That cow three blocks away? Totally unbothered. Herd Hysteria fixes that by giving your animals a healthy collective fear response, because nothing says "survival instinct" like fleeing in a group.

 Introducing Farm Fear™

We took that banyard panic and gave it a firmware update. Farm Fear™ is our proprietary\ intensity engine, letting you tune how spooked your livestock get, from a mild moo of concern to full stampede-grade bedlam. Dial it in per world with a config file or a server command.

 \ Not actually proprietary.

Every 16×16 chunk is assigned a completely random biome during world generation. No matter where you explore, the next chunk could be a desert, jungle, snowy plains, badlands, Deep Dark, or any other biome in the game.

 🎮 Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

customfigura:
Custom Figura

A fork of Figura that points the avatar backend at a
 self-hosted server instead of the Figura cloud - made for offline-mode 
servers where the official backend can't be used.

Pair it with the FiguraBackend plugin on your
server and players see each other's avatars with no Figura cloud, no Mojang authentication,
no Ely.By / authlib-injector .

 What's different from upstream Figura
Only the network layer is changed - everything else (Lua scripting, animations, rendering,
pings) is untouched :
- Backend talks plain http:// / ws:// to your server (no TLS / shared-hosting friendly).
- No Mojang handshake. The client authenticates with a one-time token the server plugin
 hands it over a trusted in-game channel ( figura:auth ) when you join.
- Offline UUIDs supported. Players with version-3 UUIDs are fully visible, not just
 premium accounts.

 Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.1

mob-level:
Every mob now has a level. Survival just got a difficulty curve.

 

---

MobLevel attaches a level to every creature in the world. That level
silently rewrites the mob's health, damage, drops, and experience. A level-3
zombie is a pushover. A level-150 zombie is a boss fight you didn't ask for —
faster than you, immune to the sun, and it cheats death once.

The catch: power has to be earned and found , not farmed in an afternoon.

 How leveling works

Level 20 is the vanilla baseline — a level-20 cow is exactly the cow you
already know. From there:

- Below 20 mobs are weaker than vanilla and their loot gets scarcer the
 lower they go.
- Above 20 mobs scale up in health, damage, loot, and XP.

 
 Spoiler: exact scaling numbers 

Health climbs faster than damage, so high-level mobs are tanky before they are
lethal — you get time to realise what you walked into.

 Level Health Damage Loot

CobbleSnack

CobbleSnack is a client-side Poké Snack calculator for Cobblemon. Select a Pokémon and its form, and CobbleSnack searches the spawn data available in your installed setup to recommend suitable seasonings and locations.

Press K to open CobbleSnack. You can change this under Options → Controls → Key Binds → Open CobbleSnack.

 Features

- Calculates a recommended three-seasoning Poké Snack
- Searches available biomes and spawn routes
- Supports Pokémon with different regional and alternate forms
- Clearly identifies structure-specific and fishing-only routes
- Shows estimated odds, required conditions, nearby blocks, ground blocks, fluids, structures, and fishing rods
- Marks estimates when the game does not provide enough information for an exact percentage
- Includes options for practical habitats, Bite Reducer, excluding enchanted golden apples, and prioritizing shiny odds

MLua 
 
 
 
 
 -- 
 
 
 
MLua lets you write Minecraft mod scripts in Lua. Scripts can interact with the game through APIs for players, worlds, events, commands, UI, and registered content.

 API reference

MLua would generate its documentation in the Minecraft client. Open run/mlua/docs/index.html after launching the game. It shows you the APIs available in that build.

 Example
 lua
local Players = Minecraft:GetService("Players")
local World = Minecraft:GetService("World")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
 player:SendMessage("Hello from MLua!")
 player:SetGameMode(GameMode.Creative)
end)

World:SetWeather(Weather.Clear)
 

 Using MLua from another mod

Include MLua with your mod and declare it as a dependency.

goldens-better-enchanting:
Unlock Enchants
 

Once you collect 6 books of any enchant and level in a nearby Chiseled Bookshelf (e.g 6 Efficiency V books), you now have access to that enchantment for free.

 Unlock Levels
 

Starting out, the enchanting table will only give level 1 enchants, in order to receive higher levels you must have 6 books of the level below the level you want to receive. E.g 6 Efficiency 1 books to begin receiving Efficiency 2 via the random enchant.

 Increase Chance
 

Each additional enchanted book put into a nearby chiseled bookshelf increases the odds of receiving that same enchant again randomly.

Though, once you have 6 enchanted books of a specific enchant, you won't receive it anymore randomly. This is so you can systematically collect enchants.

 Costs

Random enchant costs now follow a scale based on how many levels it has.

 Enchant XP Levels Enchant XP Levels Enchant XP Levels

Do you ever feel like armor in Minecraft is easily skipped? In vanilla, you can jump straight from leather to iron, or even rush diamonds without ever touching chainmail. Whole tiers of armor are often ignored.

This project fixes that by making armor upgrades linear and dependent on each other. To get to the next tier, you’ll need the full previous set. That way, players have to work their way up step by step, making each tier feel meaningful instead of disposable.

Leather First: All armor progression begins with leather. No more skipping the “starter tier.” You’ll need leather armor before moving forward.

Then Copper:Next would be copper

 Background
This mod is inspired by a YouTube video by Fundy, in which he briefly shows a custom Redstone block that can be controlled via a browser. This part of the video never got released as a standalone mod, so this is where Webstone comes in.

 Usage
The mod opens up a WebSocket server on port 4321, which then lets you connect with any WebSocket client (like this one - or the hosted client at http://webstone.festival.tf) to toggle registered blocks or change their output signal strength.

cull-display-entities:
Cull Display Entities

Implements visibility bounding boxes for Display Entities.

Minecraft uses Frustum Culling, which in simple terms hides things that are behind the camera.

However, by default blockdisplay entities have this optimization disabled when the "width" and "height" tag are not set (see the Minecraft Wiki "Tags common to all display entities").
Because most servers don't set this property when using blockdisplay entities, this means that they won't get culled on the client, when behind the camera. This
mod fixes that issue, by calculating the bounding box for unconfigured blockdisplay entities. This also has the advantage of culling the entities when
using Entity Culling.
This can improve performance, especially when the server/world you are playing in has a lot of display entities.

specter-companion:
A Specter is the equivalent to a "Ghost" from the videogame Destiny (2014); they follow the player, guarding them from death and healing them when the player's health is low, or removing toxins (Poison).

 Getting a Specter

1. Find a Specter Core in a Jungle Pyramid or Desert Temple.
2. Craft a Condensed Specter with a Specter Core, copper ingots, and some wool.
3. Right-click with the item in hand to summon your Specter!

 Behavior

 Prevents the player from dying (under most circumstances).
 Heals the player quickly when their health drops too low (below half).
 Zombies/Husk/Drowned have a percent chance to spawn with a Specter (configurable)
 The Condensed Specter can be dyed like leather armor, or renamed in an anvil!

 Notes

Suggestions are welcome! Please leave a comment with any ideas/issues you have!

🧀 치지직 데이터팩 링크 (Chzzk Datapack Link) 

 
 
 
 
 

치지직(Chzzk) 라이브 방송의 채팅과 후원 이벤트를 마인크래프트 NBT 스토리지 및 데이터팩과 실시간으로 연동 해주는 패브릭(Fabric) 모드입니다.

 🌐 English Documentation 
 ⚠️ 안내 : 본 모드는 네이버(NAVER)의 공식 모드가 아닌 비공식 오픈소스 서드파티 모드이며, AI 코딩 어시스턴트의 지원을 받아 제작되었습니다. 
 💡 필수 : 본 모드는 치지직 이벤트를 마인크래프트 스토리지로 전달하는 브릿지(Bridge) 모드 이므로, 이벤트를 받아 실행할 데이터팩이 필요 합니다.

---

 📖 개요

치지직 방송의 채팅과 후원을 마인크래프트 데이터팩으로 받아 처리할 수 있게 해주는 모드입니다.

별도의 자바 코딩 없이 데이터팩 펑션( .mcfunction )만 작성하면 시청자 참여 콘텐츠(채팅으로 블록 소환, 후원 시 몹 소환, 투표 등)를 바로 구현할 수 있습니다.

---

 ✨ 주요 기능

- 데이터팩 연동 : 채팅이나 후원이 오면 스토리지에 데이터를 병합하고 chklink:chat , chklink:donation 태그에 등록된 펑션들을 매크로와 함께 자동 실행합니다.
- 명령어 및 인자 자동 분리 :
 - !소환 좀비 3 ➔ cmd: "소환" , chat: "좀비 3" 
 - !소환, 좀비, 3 ➔ cmd: "소환" , arg0: "좀비" , arg1: "3" , arg count: 2 자동 제공
- 멀티플레이 지원 : 서버에 여러 플레이어가 있어도 각자 본인의 치지직 채널 ID로 개별 연동할 수 있습니다.
- 인게임 설정창 & Mod Menu 연동 : 인게임에서 F6 키를 누르거나 Mod Menu 의 모드 목록 설정 버튼을 통해 채널 ID를 입력하고

cleaner-caves:
Description
Removes blocks such as andesite, granite, dirt, and gravel from cave generation. Also removes similar blobs in the Nether. Does not remove surface blocks, such as dirt, and many of these can be crafted or found in other places. Leaves ores in the same places.

Similar packs, such as this one (which does not remove dirt blobs), have been made in the past. I have come across that pack, and decided it would be different enough to not be a direct copy. Please support other creators who had the idea first.

 Versions
Supports Java 1.21.5 - 26.3

Short Summary / 简短摘要

 中文： 月尖塔 为 Minecraft 提供牌组构筑式回合制战斗与登塔挑战。玩家可通过传送门进入塔大厅，规划路线、挑战房间、管理塔内卡组，并依据敌人意图制定出牌策略。

 English: Moon Spire adds deck-building turn-based combat and tower runs to Minecraft. Enter the tower lobby through a portal, plan routes, clear rooms, manage a run-specific deck, and make tactical plays around enemy intents.

 中文简介

Client-only fix for Iris on Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric & NeoForge).

- Native Wayland — the compositor forbids moving a visible cursor, so the warp does nothing
 and the value snaps to zero / a wrong number .

This client-side mod fixes both.

 What it does

- X11 / XWayland — feeds Create the live cursor position, so the saved value always matches
 where your cursor is.

Phat's Progression Framework is a config-driven mining tier system for Minecraft. Reassign vanilla tools to new tiers, gate iron ore behind copper, extend progression past netherite — entirely through JSON. No item registration, no worldgen, no content. Just a flexible foundation for modpack progression.

Most Minecraft progression mods either add their own tiers (forcing you to use their tools) or bolt new metals onto the vanilla system (capping at netherite). This mod takes a different approach: it lets modpack developers choose how the existing tools, blocks, and modded materials fit together. Want copper to gate iron ore? One config line. Want runite tools above netherite? Two config lines. Want adamantine ore to require Mythic Metals' end-game tools? You get the idea.

 Features

XP-Health is a Minecraft datapack that dynamically scales a player's maximum health based on their experience level.
As players level up, their health steadily increases, starting from 5 hearts at level 0. Each subsequent level adds half a additional heart, up to a maximum of 255 hearts at level 500. Once players reach level 500, their experience points are reset to 0 and capped at level 500, preventing any further health increases beyond this point. This datapack provides a powerful incentive for players to continue exploring, fighting, and gaining experience, as their health grows with every level.

Fog Stalker

Fog Stalker introduces a natural stealth mechanic tied to weather conditions. During rain or thunderstorms, hostile mobs have their detection range significantly reduced, simulating reduced visibility in poor weather. This affects zombies, skeletons, spiders, and other common hostile mobs by lowering their follow range attribute when precipitation is active. When the weather clears, detection ranges return to normal.

This creates emergent gameplay where players can use storms as cover for risky travel or base raids, while clear skies mean heightened danger.

 Technical Details

- Lightweight tick function that checks weather state and applies or removes attribute modifiers
- Only processes when weather actually changes to minimize performance impact
- No player-exposed commands
- Runs seamlessly in survival without requiring player interaction
- Effect applies globally to a

Overview
 
The Bombardier M5000 is a high-floor, articulated light rail vehicle (tram), part of the Flexity Swift family, built by Bombardier Transportation (later Alstom) between 2007 and 2022 in Bautzen, Germany and Vienna, Austria. Introduced into service in December 2009, the M5000 progressively replaced the older T-68/T-68A fleet, taking over all services on the Manchester Metrolink by May 2014.

Each unit is approximately 28.4 m long, 2.65 m wide, and 3.67 m high, with three bogies—two powered at each end and one under the articulation. The lightweight aluminium structure gives the vehicle an empty weight of around 39.7 t. The maximum operating speed is 50 mph (80 km/h).

blockpixel-extend-ctm:
Connected Textures for BlockPixel
This pack enables some connected texture features for the resourcepack BlockPixel. 
OptifineHD or Continuity is Required for this pack to work.

- Connections between the same type of glass become smooth.
- Grass, sand, and gravel now have pixelated gradients between them.

 About BlockPixel Extend Project
BlockPixel Extend is a resourcepack project that extends the original BlockPixel, launched by GrakePCH. This project is authorized by the author of BlockPixel, Jakob.zero. The project focuses on improving the completeness of BlockPixel to support Mods and Optifine custom textures.  Why are there two resource packs? 

Every item frame has a red arrow: this is the direction the item frame points away from the block. The model also has one chosen direction, shown with the red arrow in the pack renders.

yaupak: A performance-optimizing resource pack designed specifically for mobile devices (such as PojavLauncher) and low-end PCs. For optimal performance, it is recommended to use this pack alongside the Sodium and Lithium mods. If you are using a lower-end computer, this is a no-brainer download; however, one downside is that it is less effective in the End or the Nether.

Detailed Description 

- Netherite Redrawn is a visual rework of Netherite equipment focused on clarity, material readability, and internal consistency.
- The goal is not to redesign Netherite conceptually, but to redraw it with cleaner pixel clusters, more deliberate contrast, and a unified visual language across all items.

- clearer edges
- reduced visual noise
- more consistent shading
- improved distinction between metal, edge, and handle materials
- The redraw avoids exaggerated highlights or stylization. Shading is kept restrained to remain compatible with vanilla lighting and existing texture packs.
- This pack is intended for players who want Netherite to look more refined without breaking the original Minecraft aesthetic.

 Contents

justenoughrecipes:
What JustEnoughRecipes does

JustEnoughRecipes makes sure that Fabric mods like Just Enough Items (JEI) keep
working when you play on a non-modded server.

Starting with Minecraft 1.21.2, recipe syncing changed in a way that prevents JEI to work in a non-modded environment. Because of that, Fabric clients no longer receive the recipe
data they expect, and mods such as JEI can stop showing recipes or behave
incorrectly.

When a player joins the server, JustEnoughRecipes collects all crafting recipes
from the server and sends them to the client in the format Fabric mods expect.
This happens automatically and does not change gameplay in any way.

In simple terms:

- Bukkit / Spigot / Paper has the recipes
- Fabric mods need those recipes
- JustEnoughRecipes sends them from the server to the client

This allows mods like Just Enough Items to continue working on non-modded servers

While Mojang has made attempts to address this issue in the past, it still remains in the game to this day. PearlFix provides a reliable method to prevent players from clipping into or through blocks when using Ender Pearls.

 Showcase
For a visual showcase and a detailed explanation of how the plugin works, please refer to the 
GitHub repository.

 Permissions
- pearlfix.reload – Allows reloading the plugin configuration.

 Installation
1. Download the latest release from the Releases page.
2. Place the plugin JAR file into your server’s plugins directory.
3. Configure the config.yml file located in plugins/PearlFix/ as needed.
4. Apply changes using the /pearlfix reload command.

No KB Delay 
This plugin fixes a bug which causes entity positions to not be updated on the client immediately after being knocked back. This causes knockback to feel delayed or laggy.

This impacts all players the same. This means that regardless of if you are on high or low ping, this will reduce the delay for when you see entities take knockback by the same amount. This issue even happens on single player, and can be seen in the minecraft bug report MC-297196.
